old20_policy: Kept unchanged as historical dataset, strict nearest-arm version collects 50 fresh real trajectories
position_reference: Actual collision mesh geometry center, not actor origin
arm_selection_rule: Choose Euclidean nearest fixed shoulder before planning; after settling recompute with actual pose. Reject ambiguous margin<20mm or unexpected arm, do not change label.

post_settle_pose_checks.upright: PCA long axis <=15 degrees from world vertical
post_settle_pose_checks.horizontal: PCA long axis <=15 degrees from table plane and XY azimuth within20 degrees of0/180
post_settle_pose_checks.diagonal: PCA long axis <=15 degrees from table plane and XY azimuth35..65 degrees from0/180

formal_success_requirements: Native unassisted bottle lift and physical support verified
No fixed constraint, no bottle pose writes during grasp
Validate no table support when airborne
Both hands remain in physical traces
Three D435 RGB streams and state/action timing must follow recording contract
